remarks: Discover the perfect blend of luxury and leisure at 127 Lansdowne where every detail is designed to elevate your living experience. This exquisite 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home spans a generous 2,100 square feet, promising a lifestyle of luxury, tranquility and maintenance-free living  The large, eat-in kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring a cozy fireplace and custom built-ins that overlook a picturesque park area and gazebo on the sweeping lawns of Lansdowne. This space seamlessly combines functionality and charm, making it ideal for both everyday meals and entertaining. Step outside to your private terrace where you can savor al fresco dining or simply unwind while enjoying this beautifully landscaped oasis.  Residents of this prestigious, gated community enjoy exclusive amenities including a pool, tennis courts and all that Westport's vibrant town has to offer. Don't miss the opportunity to call this special property your own.
